technical.summary: WMT shows short-term bullish momentum with RSI9 overbought and stoch bullish cross, but weak ADX trend strength and intermediate-term moving average misalignment limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: WMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, and earnings arriving in 67 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior member 85 days prior; market fear (40/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and recent insider conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (421.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, and CPI event just occurred; 67-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term RSI9 overbought with stoch bullish cross and price above major moving averages provides tactical momentum entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), weak trend strength (ADX 20.12), intermediate-term MA misalignment, below-average volume, and high earnings risk in 67 days create unfavourable risk/reward for swing entry.
